objective: number of bins used: sum of y[bin]

weight.description: Capacity the item takes up in the bin it is packed into
weight.label: item weight

bin.description: Candidate bin identifier (the original offers one bin per item)
bin.label: bin

capacity.description: Most weight the bin can hold when it is used
capacity.label: bin capacity

decision_variables.x[item, bin]: binary, 1 if the item is packed into the bin
decision_variables.y[bin]: binary, 1 if the bin is used

constraints.assign[item]: sum_b x[item, b] = 1 (every item is packed exactly once)
constraints.capacity[bin]: sum_i weight[i] * x[i, bin] <= capacity[bin] * y[bin] (only a used bin holds weight)
